deadline.value: The Fall deadline is November 15; applications are reviewed in December and January.

also.quote: The deadline to apply is November 15th.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

fee_waiver.value: Domestic applicants can have the fee waived in the October 19-26 free week. Internationals do not get a waiver.
fee_waiver.quote: Free application week for domestic students is October 19-26th!

supervisor.value: Students choose an advisor after first-year lab rotations, not before admission.
supervisor.quote: Choosing an advisor prior to arriving on campus is not required. | All incoming students are expected to rotate through laboratories in the first year before selecting a faculty advisor

funding.value: Graduate assistantships are awarded competitively to qualified PhD students; admission and funding decisions are made together.
funding.quote: The school offers 12-month graduate assistantships on a competitive basis to qualified PhD students.

entry_route.value: Applicants with a bachelor's degree or higher can enter; master's holders follow a shorter credit path.
entry_route.quote: Bachelor's degree or higher from an accredited college or university | Post-master's students must complete a minimum of 30 credit hours prior to enrolling in BMS 80199

notes: Five Ph.D. tracks: Cellular and Molecular Biology, Human Evolutionary Biology, Neurosciences (tagged neuro), Pharmacology and Physiology Interdisciplinary. Deadline and English minimums come from the Cellular and Molecular Biology page; the other tracks were not fetched. The graduate school table also lists 94/7.0 for all biomedical programs.
name: Biomedical Sciences (Ph.D. tracks)
